title: EXCLUSIVE: Ouai and Heaven Mayhem Team Up on Refillable Fragrance Necklaces
summary: The amulet necklaces bring together Ouai’s signature scents and Heaven Mayhem’s vintage-inspired jewelry designs.
ai_summary: Ouai and Heaven Mayhem collaborate to create refillable fragrance necklaces that combine signature scents with vintage-inspired jewelry designs. The partnership offers a unique blend of beauty and accessory elements in a single product.
